notes: Checked 2026-10-09. The complete 40,410-character markdown was read in four contiguous chunks, including the references and final figures on pp. 15-21. PDF text was used to verify the quoted passages, author, sections and end matter. The PDF has 21 pages, no identified appendix or supplementary section, and no embedded files. Its only external links are the article DOI and Creative Commons license; both returned HTTP 200. forms/c255.json data_and_code.data_url and code_url are empty. No explicit data/code/materials availability statement, on-request promise, public teaching-platform address or preregistration was found. The recorded statements describe licensing and submission/storage of student work; they do not establish public access. Publication assets and demonstrably unrelated search hits are documented under searches and excluded from deposits. No relevant data file with participant identifiers, instructional-arm assignments, outcome scores or a complete text/idea corpus was located. Therefore none of final.open_items can be resolved from confirmed public data: analyzed student counts by arm/outcome, missingness/exclusions, control-arm results, per-person means, SDs, SEs, observation/aggregation units, or image-to-student mappings remain unavailable. Text/idea diversity cannot be estimated by arm from the selected quotations and illustrative images. The allocation procedure, assessment AI access, scoring rubrics and conflicting printed results also remain unresolved. High confidence refers to the documented none-found result, not proof that the author holds no data or that an unindexed deposit cannot exist. The OSF name query searches titles rather than contributors. No login, account creation, access request or author contact was attempted.
